idea-plugin.name: Code Map
idea-plugin.description:
Code Map: a live, left-to-right call-flow explorer for Python projects, right inside PyCharm.

  • The call graph is built from PyCharm's own Python code model (the same resolve and type inference as navigation): calls, FastAPI Depends, instantiations, inheritance, overrides, callbacks, routers. No Python interpreter or extra process is needed; nothing leaves your machine.
  • Entrypoints: HTTP / WebSocket routes (with router prefixes), Celery tasks, __main__ blocks, app factories, CLI commands and framework hooks.
  • Updates live as you edit (unsaved changes included); the first build shows progress and waits for indexing.
  • "Open Code Map" (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K, Tools / View menu): the map in an editor tab (JCEF), or in your browser if JCEF is unavailable. Ctrl+click a node to jump to the code.
  • "Show in Code Map" (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M, editor / project view popup): focuses the graph on the function or class at the caret.
  • Served by the IDE's built-in server at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/codemap/ (localhost only).
  • Settings | Tools | Code Map: exclude globs, include test code.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.0: analysis moved into the plugin: the graph is built from PyCharm's Python code model (PSI, resolve, type inference) instead of a bundled Python process, so no Python interpreter is required and more calls resolve; live updates on edits, including unsaved ones; served by the IDE's built-in server under /codemap/ (no extra port); the map shows indexing/analysis progress itself; settings reduced to exclude globs and test code.
0.4.0: bundled mode — the plugin contains the codemap server and starts it automatically (finds Python 3.10+, random port, stops with the IDE); the tab opens immediately with a starting page and shows errors with Retry / Open Settings; new settings: server mode, Python interpreter, status, restart.
0.3.0: each project gets its own map (server analyses the open project's directory).
0.2.0: Code Map opens as an editor tab instead of a tool window.
0.1.0: initial version.
